name: Jin-hae

items.name: Feng Huo Lun
items.description: Also known as wind and fire wheels, these large, flat steel rings feature several protruding blades typically stylized to resemble flames.

items.name: Hook Sword
items.description: This long sword has a hook near the tip, making it easy to snag an opponent or their weapons.

generalAbilities.name: Link Swords
generalAbilities.description:
Requirements Jin-Hae is wielding two hook swords

Effect Jin-Hae either links her swords together or unlinks them. If the swords are linked, she can make linked hook sword Strikes; if the swords are unlinked, she can make hook sword Strikes.

savenote: -1 status penalty to all saves vs. death effects

defensiveAbilities.name: -1 status penalty to all saves vs. death effects
Attack of Opportunity
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger A creature within the monster's reach uses a manipulate action or a move action, makes a ranged attack, or leaves a square during a move action it's using.

Effect The monster attempts a melee Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack is a critical hit and the trigger was a manipulate action, the monster disrupts that action. This Strike doesn't count toward the monster's multiple attack penalty, and its multiple attack penalty doesn't apply to this Strike.

defensiveAbilities.name: Susceptible to Death
defensiveAbilities.description:
Though phantoms aren't alive, neither are they undead, and they are uniquely vulnerable to the effects of death.

A phantom whose Hit Points are reduced to 0 as a result of a death effect (such as from a spell like Execute) is immediately whisked away to the River of Souls, where their soul resumes the usual path to the afterlife.

offensiveAbilities.name: Call a Battle Echo
offensiveAbilities.description: Effect Jin-Hae pulls one of the battle echoes to her hand. She is fully aware of every echo and can always pull the one she wants, but she cannot call an echo that has already been unsealed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Combined Charge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Frequency once per day

Trigger Cloudsplitter Strides or Tramples within 5 feet of Jin-Hae

Effect Jin-Hae leaps onto Cloudsplitter's back as he charges. She can make a single melee attack against any target they pass during Cloudsplitter's movement.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wind-Fire Charge
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Jin-Hae is wielding her feng huo lun

Effect Jin-Hae blasts off on her feng huo lun, leaving an elemental trail in her wake. She Strides up to twice her Speed and makes a feng huo lun Strike at any point during her movement. The path left by her movement is filled with her choice of an 8th-rank Wall of Wind or Wall of Fire spell. Jin-Hae is unaffected by any walls she creates with this ability. She cannot use Wind-Fire Charge again for 1d4 rounds. If she uses Wind-Fire Charge again, the wall created by her previous Wind-Fire Charge disappears as soon as her action is completed.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wind-Fire Chariot
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Jin-Hae is wielding two feng huo lun

Effect Jin-Hae's feng huo lun float by her feet, giving her the benefits of 7th- level Migration. While this lasts, she can wield her feng huo lun even while her hands are full by kicking with them, and her feng huo lun gain the thrown 20 feet trait as well as the effects of a returning rune.

lv7spells.name: Air Walk (Constant)
lv7spells.description: The target can walk on air as if it were solid ground. It can ascend and descend in this way at a maximum of a 45-degree angle.
